name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on acquiring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada, primarily targeting gold. The company holds a 50% exploration earn-in and a 3% net smelter royalty at the Lapon Canyon gold project in Nevada, where 2025-2026 reverse circulation drill programs have returned significant intercepts including 3.05 g/t Au over 53.3 m. The company is targeting completion of an initial NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate at Lapon Canyon in 2026.
